chapter: Youth, the road and arrival in California
title: Coleman Hawkins as a kind man
summary: He recounts a dream about Ben Webster and Hawkins and the thrill of Hawkins speaking to him as a kid.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Coleman Hawkins and the great saxophonists

blocks.x: Well, I had gotten to know Coleman Hawkins, you know, very briefly -- but what a beautiful human being he was. At least to me. He talked to me, and you know, being the kind of kid I was, I was just enthralled that he would speak to me. Because I used to stand in front of the
bands, and I know they didn't know this would be the same kid that years later was still hanging around. It was just a thrill to hear Coleman Hawkins at this Henry's...
